rows.en:
(Swimming's next, huh...
What a pain...)

Excuse me, you there.
Do you have a moment?
Huh!? Oh, Sheryl!?
What? Am I really such a rare sight?
No, it's just...

Well, I can't blame you. After all, the Sheryl
Nome herself is right here at a school pool!

Go on, feast your eyes on me in my swimsuit
to your heart's content!

I guess an ordinary school life just isn't
possible for someone like me after all...
Um, uh...

It's fine, it's not your fault.
The problem is that I'm Sheryl...
Oh, I have to go. Sorry.
(...I didn't even say anything...)

(Swimming's next...
Could be kind of a pain...)
Huh!? Oh, Sheryl-san!?
Oh my? Am I really such a rare sight?
No, it's not like that...
Yeah, well...

Go on, feast your eyes on me
to your heart's content!
(...Sheryl-san really is something...)
(Okay, I'd better get ready for the next class...)

Oh, what was the next class again?
You there, tell me.
rows.notes: Sheryl's line (male scene); its third use, near the end of both nml_she_014 branches, carries no name plate (PLAYER/none), apparently a leftover; translated for Sheryl.

rows.en: Um, I think it's Space History.

Sounds like a boring class.
Maybe I'll skip it.

Huh? Are you allowed to just do
whatever you want like that?

What are you saying? I'm Sheryl.
Sheryl Nome!
I won't be ruled by some class timetable!

Well, all right. If you insist that much,
maybe I'll sit in on this class after all.
Well, I suppose so...

(Sheryl really is something,
whatever she does...)
(Okay, I need to get ready for the next class...)

Oh, what was the next class again?
You there, would you tell me?
Um, it's Space History.
Huh? Is it really okay to do that?
I think that's a good idea...
(That's so Sheryl-san.)
(Lunchtime, huh. What should I eat...)

Honestly, Grace,
this isn't what I asked for!
Huh? Sheryl? I wonder what's wrong...

I told you I wanted to eat these things called
a "katsu sandwich" and "coffee milk," didn't I?

It can't be helped. The school store was already
packed with students, there was no way in.
I'm afraid I just couldn't...
Honestly, you're no help at all!
I'm sorry.
Oh, you've come at just the right time.
Who else would I be talking to?
F-fair enough...

Sorry, but go to the school store and buy me
a "katsu sandwich" and a "coffee milk"!

I'll make it worth your while.
Now, off you go!

(Phew, I'm glad I managed to buy them...
Sheryl seemed happy with them, too.)
(Lunchtime already. Hmm, what to eat...)
Huh? Sheryl-san? What's wrong, I wonder...
Y-you're right...

I'll make it worth your while.
I'm counting on you!

(Phew, I'm glad I managed to buy them...
Sheryl-san seemed happy with them, too.)

(Okay, classes are over. Maybe I'll stop
somewhere on the way home... Oh, it's Sheryl.
Maybe I'll go talk to her...)

Hey, Sheryl. If you're free after this,
want to stop by somewhere with me?
Huh? What? Are you talking to me?
Yeah, but only if you're free...

I see...
I'll check my schedule with Grace.
Wait a moment.
"Hello, Grace? It's me..."

Looks like my schedule's clear.
So, where will you be taking me?
Hmm, I haven't really thought about that...

What? What's that supposed to mean? How rude!
If you're going to invite someone,
think it through beforehand!
Oh, sorry...

Well... I'll let it slide this time.
Now, let's go.

(I just spent an ordinary afternoon after school
with the Galactic Fairy...
Maybe I got a little lucky!)

(Okay, classes are over. Maybe I'll stop
somewhere on the way home... Oh, it's
Sheryl-san. Maybe I'll invite her along...)

Um, Sheryl-san. If you're free after this,
would you like to stop by somewhere with me?
Yes, but only if you're free...
Um, I haven't really thought about that...
Oh, I'm sorry...

(Who'd have thought I'd spend an ordinary
afternoon after school with the Galactic Fairy...
I got kind of lucky!)

uncertain: c19824: third use has no name plate (PLAYER/none) at the end of both nml_she_014 branches, likely a script leftover; translated as Sheryl's line.
c19839: kono-na no kiitenai wa read as 'this isn't what I asked for' (Grace failed to get the food Sheryl requested).
c19841/c19848: katsu sando -> 'katsu sandwich', kohii gyunyu -> 'coffee milk' (not in glossary; school store food items, kept in quotes as in the Japanese).
c19825/c19834: uchuushi class -> 'Space History' (not in glossary).
